name: Elizabeth Robinson
source:
While she is a fan of Porter Robinson, Elizabeth Robinson is often told she is an angel, she's usually sweet, caring and passionate about others but if she's in a debate, she will push it beyond her limits, trying every inch to win it.

[From [url=https://thediamondcryst.itch.io/daring-academy]Itch.io[/url]]
